records.question: Which combination explains both the standard return window and the evidence fields support must record? Include the other relevant detail.
required_facts: record plan, channel, delivery date, and remedy.
records.raw_candidate_excerpt: The combination that explains both the standard return window and evidence fields is found in **[s.filesystem:standard-returns-2026/Standard Returns — 2026/Case record]**, which states before approving a request you must "record [the plan], order channel, delivery date, product type, requested remedy" while keeping the case pending if any of those fields are unknown. Additional relevant detail is in **[s.filesystem:employee-handbook-en/Employee and Customer Operations Handbook/32. Campaigns and plan changes]**, which clarifies that "a campaign label does not replace the Standard or Premium return policy."
citations: Employee and Customer Operations Handbook/32. Campaigns and plan changes
